command: set +e; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; ./gradlew :feature:details:detekt --console=plain >/tmp/p3c-detekt-v42.out 2>&1; rc=$?; echo DETEKT_EXIT_CODE=$rc; echo CONSOLE_DETAILS; grep -n Details /tmp/p3c-detekt-v42.out || true; echo REPORT_FILES; find feature/details/build/reports -type f -name '*detekt*' -print | sort; echo TEXT_REPORTS; for f in $(find feature/details/build/reports -type f -name '*.txt'); do echo FILE=$f; cat "$f"; done; exit 0
